description: Page navigation control with previous/next buttons, numbered page links with ellipsis for large ranges, optional page-size selector dropdown, and item count display. Test hooks: the root carries data-testid="pagination", the item-range text "pagination-info", the step buttons "pagination-prev" / "pagination-next", each page button "pagination-page-{n}" and the page-size select "pagination-page-size"; the active page button is marked aria-current="page". TestIdPrefix namespaces all of them ("users-pagination-next"), DataTestId overrides the root id only. Select on these, not on the CSS classes.

parameters.name: Compact
parameters.description: Whether to render the compact page-count presentation.

parameters.name: ShowInfo
parameters.description: Whether the "X-Y of Z" item range label is rendered inside the pagination bar. Default true, which is what a standalone pager needs. A host that already states the range next to the pager — as TmDataTable does with its own summary — sets this to false so the count is not printed twice.

examples.title: Standalone pagination
examples.code:
<TmPagination CurrentPage="@currentPage"
              TotalPages="@totalPages"
              TotalCount="@totalCount"
              PageSize="25"
              PageSizeOptions="@(new[] { 10, 25, 50, 100 })"
              OnPageChange="page => currentPage = page"
              OnPageSizeChange="HandlePageSizeChange" />
